title: NVIDIA security advisory (AV26-849)
description: As of August 25, 2026, NVIDIA is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product:
products:
NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell
Multiple versions

NVIDIA Unified Fabric Manager
Multiple versions and models

NVIDIA DGX Spark
Versions prior to 1.110.13
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
